name: Woodlawn Campground
note: No-frills wooded campground half a block off US-13 at the Delaware line in Delmar, on Maryland's lower Eastern Shore. Operator's own site: $50/night for two people, $5 per additional person over seven, dump station $20, refundable deposit with 48-hour cancellation; water and electric hookups at 30 amp and gravel pull-through trailer sites, with showers, modern restrooms, laundry, wifi and a playground. Third-party listings count 32 sites with 14 pull-throughs and put the season at April-October; the operator states neither, nor a maximum RV length. Reservations through the booking link on the operator's site. The campground is heavily wooded with pruned trees, which is why the pads do not read on satellite. Note the town straddles the state line - the campground is on the Maryland side though some directories file it under Delmar, DE. RV Life 4*/$$ ~$28/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator's own rates and reservation pages at woodlawncampground.com (fetched 2026-09-15): $50/night for two, water + 30-amp electric, gravel pull-through trailer sites, dump station, and a live online booking link -> a real nightly-bookable drive-in RV campground. Corroborated as currently operating by a VisitMaryland.org listing and a Yelp page updated August 2026. US Census geocoder and RV Life's own pin agree within 8 m on 1209 Walnut St, and that parcel is the wooded block just west of US-13 matching the 'half a block off Route 13' description.

lead.water_body: none on site; operator cites fishing in 'nearby ponds and rivers'
lead.note: No water body is visible on or adjacent to the parcel in leaf-off Esri imagery, and the operator's own wording puts the ponds and rivers NEARBY rather than on site. One aggregator mentions a 'beach area' - unconfirmed and not supported by imagery. Canopy hides the pads, so treat the satellite as non-confirming rather than as evidence either way.
